108:   g_worker_ready = true;
109:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
110:   for (;;)
111:     {
112:       struct pwc_message message;
113:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
114:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
115:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
116:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
117:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
118:         {
119:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
120:             /* The unmodified AVDK SMP firmware returns the requested ON/OFF
121:              * state in param1. It does not expose the PSRAM driver result or
122:              * detected capacity, so AP validates its configured regions with
123:              * the non-destructive boundary probe before creating allocators.
124:              */
125: 
126:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
127:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
128:               {
129:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
130:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
131:               }
132:             break;
133: 
134: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
135:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
136:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
137:               {
138:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
139:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
140:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
141:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
142:               }
143:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
144:               {
145:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
146: 
147:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
148:               }
149:             break;
150: 
151:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
152:             bk7258_psram_dump();
153:             break;
154: 
155:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
156:             {
157:               int ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
158: 
159:               (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
160:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
161:                 ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
162:                            PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
163:             }
164:             break;
165: #endif
166: 
167:           default:
168:             break;
169:         }
170:     }
171:   return 0;
172: }

174: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
175: {
176:   int pid;
177:   int ret;
178: 
179:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
180:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
181:   nxsem_init(&g_psram_power_sem, 0, 0);
182:   g_head = 0;
183:   g_tail = 0;
184:   g_worker_ready = false;
185:   g_ready_sent = false;
186:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
187:   g_psram_power_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
188:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
189:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
190:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
191:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
192:     {
193:       return -1;
194:     }
195: 
196:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
197:   if (ret < 0)
198:     {
199:       printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
200:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
201:       return ret;
202:     }
203:   printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport complete\n");
204: 
205:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
206:                      NULL) < 0)
207:     {
208:       return -1;
209:     }
210:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
211:   if (pid < 0)
212:     {
213:       return pid;
214:     }
215:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
216:       !g_worker_ready)
217:     {
218:       printf("PWC: worker start timeout\n");
219:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
220:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
221:     }
222:   printf("PWC: worker ready\n");
223: 
224:   /* CP boots CPU1 from its low-power worker and waits there for this ready
225:    * command. Send it before requesting PSRAM, whose vote is handled by that
226:    * same worker, otherwise the two cores deadlock waiting for each other.
227:    */
228: 
229:   g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD,
230:                                          1, 0, 0) == 0;
231:   if (!g_ready_sent)
232:     {
233:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready queue failed\n");
234:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
235:       return -EIO;
236:     }
237: 
238:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
239:   if (ret < 0)
240:     {
241:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
242:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
243:       return ret;
244:     }
245: 
246:   printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready acknowledged by CP transport\n");
247: 
248: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
249:   g_psram_power_waiting = true;
250:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
251:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
252:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON, 0);
253:   if (ret >= 0)
254:     {
255:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_psram_power_sem,
256:                          MSEC2TICK(PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS));
257:     }
258: 
259:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
260:   if (ret < 0 || g_psram_power_state != PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
261:     {
262:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power response failed, error=%d state=%lu\n",
263:              ret, (unsigned long)g_psram_power_state);
264:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
265:       psram_power_vote_rollback();
266: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
267:       return ret < 0 ? ret : -EIO;
268: #endif
269:     }
270:   else
271:     {
272:       /* printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote ON acknowledged\n"); */
273:       ret = bk7258_psram_initialize();
274:       if (ret < 0)
275:         {
276:           printf("PWC: PSRAM allocator initialization failed, error=%d\n",
277:                  ret);
278:           psram_power_vote_rollback();
279: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
280:           return ret;
281: #endif
282:         }
283:       else
284:         {
285:           /* printf("PWC: PSRAM allocators ONLINE\n"); */
286:         }
287:     }
288: #endif
289: 
290:   if (g_ready_sent)
291:     {
292:       return 0;
293:     }
294:

494:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
495:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
496:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
497:             g_channel_ids[i]);
498:         }
499: 
500:       active->callback = channel->callback;
501:       active->arg = channel->arg;
502:       active->channel_index = i;
503:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
504:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
505:       if (ret < 0)
506:         {
507:           return ret;
508:         }
509: 
510:       active->busy = true;
511:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
512:         {
513:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
514:             {
515:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
516:             }
517: 
518:           g_probe_attempts++;
519:           g_stats.probes++;
520:         }
521: 
522:       return OK;
523:     }
524: 
525:   return OK;
526: }
527: 
528: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
529:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
530: {
531:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
532: 
533:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
534:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
535:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
536:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
537:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
538:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
539:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
540: }
541: 
542: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
543: {
544:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
545:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
546:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
547: }
548: 
549: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
550: {
551:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
552:   struct active_transaction *active;
553:   bool replay;
554:   int result;
555: 
556:   active = busy_probe();
557:   if (active == NULL)
558:     {
559:       active = &g_active;
560:     }
561: 
562:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
563:     {
564:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
565:       return;
566:     }
567: 
568:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
569:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
570:     {
571:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
572: 
573:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
574:       return;
575:     }
576: 
577:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
578:     {
579:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
580:       return;
581:     }
582: 
583:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
584:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
585: 
586:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
587:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
588:     {
589:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
590:     }
591: 
592:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
593:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
594:   if (replay)
595:     {
596:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
597:       unsigned int i;
598: 
599:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
600:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
601:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
602:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
603:        */
604: 
605:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
606:       g_active.quarantine = false;
607:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
608:         {
609:           if (i != replay_index)
610:             {
611:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
612:             }
613:         }
614: 
615:       select_recovery_epoch();
616:       (void)dispatch_locked();
617:       return;
618:     }
619: 
620:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
621: 
622:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
623:     {
624:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
625:         {
626:           release_recovery_slots();
627:           g_recovery_index = 0;
628:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
629:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
630:         }
631:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
632:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
633:         {
634:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
635:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
636:            */
637:         }
638:       else
639:         {
640:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
641:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
642:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
643:         }
644:     }
645: 
646:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
647:            result < 0)
648:     {
649:       begin_abort(result);
650:     }
651: 
652:   (void)dispatch_locked();
653: }
654: 
655: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
656: {
657:   struct ack_slot *slot;
658:   unsigned int rx_index;
659:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
660:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
661:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
662:   uint8_t state = 0;
663:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
664: 
665:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
666:     {
667:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
668:       if (slot == NULL)
669:         {
670:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
671:           return -EAGAIN;
672:         }
673:     }
674:   else
675:     {
676:       slot = NULL;
677:     }
678: 
679:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
680:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
681:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
682:     {
683:       g_stats.bad_header++;
684:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
685:     }
686:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
687:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
688:     {
689:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
690:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
691:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
692:         {
693:           if (slot != NULL)
694:             {
695:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
696:             }
697: 
698:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
699:           return -EAGAIN;
700:         }
701:       else if (ret < 0)
702:         {
703:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
704:         }
705:     }
706:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
707:     {
708:       g_pwc_rx(message);
709:       ret = OK;
710:     }
711:   else
712:     {
713:       g_stats.unsupported++;
714:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
715:     }
716: 
717:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
718:     {
719:       return OK;
720:     }
721: 
722:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
723:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
724:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
725:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
726:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
727: 
728:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
729:     {
730:       g_probe_requested = true;
731:     }
732: 
733:   (void)dispatch_locked();
734:   return OK;
735: }
736: 
737: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
738: {
739:   irqstate_t flags;
740:   uint8_t control;
741: 
742:   flags = up_irq_save();
743:   g_stats.rx++;
744:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
745: 
746:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
747:     {
748:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
749:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
750:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
751:         {
752:           g_stats.bad_header++;
753:         }
754:       else
755:         {
756:           g_stats.resets++;
757:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
758:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
759:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
760:         }
761:     }
762:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
763:     {
764:       handle_ack(message);
765:     }
766:   else
767:     {
768:       int ret = handle_command(message);
769: 
770:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
771:         {
772:           up_irq_restore(flags);
773:           return ret;
774:         }
775:     }
776: 
777:   up_irq_restore(flags);
778:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
779:   return OK;
780: }

782: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
783: {
784:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
785: 
786:   (void)argc;
787:   (void)argv;
788:   for (;;)
789:     {
790:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
791:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
792:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
793:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
794:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
795:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
796:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
797:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
798: 
799:       up_irq_restore(flags);
800:       if (reported == state)
801:         {
802:           continue;
803:         }
804: 
805:       reported = state;
806:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
807:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
808:         {
809:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
810:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
811:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
812:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
813:         }
814: 
815:       if (callback != NULL)
816:         {
817:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
818:         }
819:     }
820: 
821:   return OK;
822: }

824: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
825: {
826:   (void)argc;
827:   (void)argv;
828: 
829:   for (;;)
830:     {
831:       struct active_transaction *probe;
832:       irqstate_t flags;
833:       bool request_probe;
834: 
835:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
836:       flags = up_irq_save();
837: 
838:       probe = busy_probe();
839:       if ((g_active.busy &&
840:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
841:           (probe != NULL &&
842:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
843:         {
844:           g_stats.timeout++;
845:           if (probe != NULL)
846:             {
847:               probe->quarantine = true;
848:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
849:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
850:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
851:             }
852:           else
853:             {
854:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
855:             }
856:         }
857: 
858:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
859:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
860:         {
861:           select_recovery_epoch();
862:         }
863: 
864:       (void)dispatch_locked();
865:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
866:         {
867:           g_probe_requested = false;
868:         }
869: 
870:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
871:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
872:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
873:       if (request_probe)
874:         {
875:           g_probe_requested = false;
876:         }
877: 
878:       up_irq_restore(flags);
879: 
880:       if (request_probe)
881:         {
882:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
883:         }
884:     }
885: 
886:   return OK;
887: }

951: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
952:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
953:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
954: {
955:   struct logical_channel *channel;
956:   unsigned int index;
957:   irqstate_t flags;
958:   int ret;
959: 
960:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
961:     {
962:       return -EAGAIN;
963:     }
964: 
965:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
966:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
967:     {
968:       return -EINVAL;
969:     }
970: 
971:   flags = up_irq_save();
972:   channel = &g_channels[index];
973:   if (channel->queued)
974:     {
975:       up_irq_restore(flags);
976:       return -EBUSY;
977:     }
978: 
979:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
980:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
981:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
982:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
983:     {
984:       up_irq_restore(flags);
985:       return -ENOLINK;
986:     }
987: 
988:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
989:     {
990:       up_irq_restore(flags);
991:       return -ENOLINK;
992:     }
993: 
994:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
995:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
996:   channel->callback = callback;
997:   channel->arg = arg;
998:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
999:   channel->queued = true;
1000:   ret = dispatch_locked();
1001:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
1002:     {
1003:       channel->queued = false;
1004:       channel->result = ret;
1005:     }
1006: 
1007:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1008:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1009:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
1010: }

1156: static int wait_channel(uint8_t logical_channel, unsigned int timeout_ms)
1157: {

1159:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1160:

1163:       return -EINVAL;

576:       return 0;
577:     }
578: 
579:   flags = up_irq_save();
580:   available = tx_free();
581:   written = length > available ? available : length;
582:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_write;
583:   if (first > written)
584:     {
585:       first = written;
586:     }
587: 
588:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
589:   if (first != written)
590:     {
591:       memcpy(g_uart.tx_ring, data + first, written - first);
592:     }
593: 
594:   g_uart.tx_write = (g_uart.tx_write + written) % MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
595:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;
596:   g_uart.stats.write_bytes += written;
597:   if (written < length)
598:     {
599:       g_uart.stats.short_writes++;
600:     }
601: 
602:   up_irq_restore(flags);
603:   if (g_uart.initialized && written != 0)
604:     {
605:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
606:     }
607: 
608:   return written;
609: }

611: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_read(uint8_t *data, size_t length,
612:                               unsigned int *status)
613: {
614:   irqstate_t flags;
615:   uint16_t available;
616:   uint16_t count;
617:   uint16_t first;
618: 
619:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
620:     {
621:       return -EINVAL;
622:     }
623: 
624:   flags = up_irq_save();
625:   available = rx_count();
626:   count = length > available ? available : length;
627:   first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_read;
628:   if (first > count)
629:     {
630:       first = count;
631:     }
632: 
633:   memcpy(data, &g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_read], first);
634:   if (first != count)
635:     {
636:       memcpy(data + first, g_uart.rx_ring, count - first);
637:     }
638: 
639:   g_uart.rx_read = (g_uart.rx_read + count) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
640:   if (status != NULL)
641:     {
642:       *status = g_uart.sticky_status;
643:       g_uart.sticky_status = 0;
644:     }
645: 
646:   if (!g_uart.upper_rts && g_uart.local_rts &&
647:       rx_count() < MB_UART_RTS_RELEASE)
648:     {
649:       update_local_rts();
650:     }
651: 
652:   up_irq_restore(flags);
653:   if (g_uart.initialized && count != 0)
654:     {
655:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
656:     }
657: 
658:   return count;
659: }

711: {

25: #define BK7258_MOTOR_DUTY        ((ub16_t)((7u * 65536u) / 10u))
26: #define BK7258_PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD   2

35: static int bk7258_motor_button_worker(int argc, char **argv)
36: {
37:   struct pwm_info_s info =
38:   {
39:     .frequency = BK7258_MOTOR_FREQUENCY,
40:     .duty = BK7258_MOTOR_DUTY,
41:   };
42:   bool candidate = false;
43:   bool pressed = false;
44:   unsigned int samples = 0;
45:   int fd;
46: 
47:   (void)argc;
48:   (void)argv;
49: 
50:   fd = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(BK7258_PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD,
51:                                BK7258_PM_CLK_ID_PWM_1,
52:                                BK7258_PM_CLK_POWER_UP, 0);
53:   if (fd < 0)
54:     {
55:       return fd;
56:     }
57: 
58:   /* 当前 PWC 仅入队请求，不等待 CP 语义响应。PWM0 时钟门控由 CP 收到
59:    * mailbox 命令后才打开，此处延时等待 CP 完成时钟使能，避免后续 PWM
60:    * 寄存器写入因时钟未就绪而丢失。待 PWC worker 补上 ACK 消费后应改为
61:    * 有界等待。
62:    */
63:   nxsig_usleep(20000);
64:   fd = open("/dev/pwm0", O_RDWR);
65:   if (fd < 0)
66:     {
67:       return -errno;
68:     }
69: 
70:   if (ioctl(fd, PWMIOC_SETCHARACTERISTICS,
71:             (unsigned long)(uintptr_t)&info) < 0)
72:     {
73:       int ret = -errno;
74:       close(fd);
75:       return ret;
76:     }
77: 
78:   printf("power-key motor worker ready, PWM parameters applied\n");
79: 
80:   for (;;)
81:     {
82:       bool sample = (board_buttons() & BUTTON_POWER_BIT) != 0;
83: 
84:       if (sample != candidate)
85:         {
86:           candidate = sample;
87:           samples = 1;
88:         }
89:       else if (samples < BK7258_KEY_DEBOUNCE_COUNT)
90:         {
91:           samples++;
92:         }
93: 
94:       if (samples == BK7258_KEY_DEBOUNCE_COUNT && pressed != candidate)
95:         {
96:           int cmd = candidate ? PWMIOC_START : PWMIOC_STOP;
97: 
98:           if (ioctl(fd, cmd, 0) < 0)
99:             {
100:               close(fd);
101:               return -errno;
102:             }
103: 
104:           pressed = candidate;
105:         }
106: 
107:       nxsig_usleep(BK7258_KEY_POLL_US);
108:     }
109: }
110: #endif

252:               g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;

271:   struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *header;
272:   uint16_t sequence;
273:   int ret;
274: 
275:   if (payload_length > BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SLOT_SIZE - sizeof(uint32_t) -
276:                        sizeof(*cpdu) - sizeof(*header))
277:     {
278:       return -E2BIG;

287:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);

289:   slot = wifi_command_alloc();

292:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
293:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);

1206:           if (!tx->active || (ap_cpdu->flags & 1u) == 0)
1207:             {
1208:               goto invalid;
1209:             }
1210: 
1211:           cp_owned[count] = false;
1212:           next = ap_cpdu->next;
1213:         }
1214:       else
1215:         {
1216:           flags = up_irq_save();
1217:           if (pending->generation !=
1218:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() ||
1219:               !wifi_cp_pointer(address, sizeof(cpdu)) ||
1220:               !wifi_copy_rx_frame(address, NULL))
1221:             {
1222:               up_irq_restore(flags);
1223:               goto invalid;
1224:             }
1225: 
1226:           memcpy(&cpdu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address, sizeof(cpdu));
1227:           up_irq_restore(flags);
1228:           cp_owned[count] = true;
1229:           next = cpdu.next;
1230:         }
1231: 
1232:       address = next;
1233:     }
1234: 
1235:   if (address != 0)
1236:     {
1237:       goto invalid;
1238:     }
1239: 
1240:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1241:     {
1242:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1243:           g_wifi.packet_count + packet_added < WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE)
1244:         {
1245:           unsigned int index = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1246:                                WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1247: 
1248:           flags = up_irq_save();
1249:           if (pending->generation ==
1250:                 bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() &&
1251:               wifi_copy_rx_frame(addresses[count], &g_wifi.packets[index]))
1252:             {
1253:               packet_added++;
1254:             }
1255:           up_irq_restore(flags);
1256:         }
1257:     }
1258: 
1259:   flags = up_irq_save();
1260:   if (pending->generation != bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation())
1261:     {
1262:       recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1263:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1264:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1265:       return;
1266:     }
1267: 
1268:   memset(&recycle->node, 0, sizeof(recycle->node));
1269:   recycle->node.channel = 2;
1270:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1271:     {
1272:       if (cp_owned[count] &&
1273:           recycle->node.num < BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1274:         {
1275:           wifi_recycle_append(&recycle->node, addresses[count]);
1276:         }
1277:     }
1278: 
1279:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
1280:   recycle->state = recycle->node.num == 0 ? WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD :
1281:                                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUED;
1282:   g_wifi.packet_tail = (g_wifi.packet_tail + packet_added) %
1283:                        WIFI_PACKET_QUEUE;
1284:   g_wifi.packet_count += packet_added;
1285: 
1286:   for (count = 0; count < node->num; count++)
1287:     {
1288:       if (!cp_owned[count])
1289:         {
1290:           struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = wifi_tx_slot(addresses[count]);
1291: 
1292:           notifications->tx_packets[notifications->tx_count++] = tx->packet;
1293:           tx->packet = NULL;
1294:           tx->active = false;
1295:           tx->transport_rejected = false;
1296:         }
1297:     }
1298:   if (packet_added != 0)
1299:     {
1300:       notifications->rxready = true;
1301:     }
1302:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1303:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1304:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1305:   return;
1306: 
1307: invalid:
1308:   flags = up_irq_save();
1309:   recycle->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1310:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1311:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1312: }

1315: static int wifi_mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1316:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
1317: {
1318:   struct bk7258_wifi_ipc_node node;
1319:   struct wifi_pending_node *pending;
1320:   irqstate_t flags;
1321: 
1322:   (void)ack_flags;
1323:   (void)arg;
1324:   memcpy(&node, message, sizeof(node));
1325:   if (node.num == 0 || node.num > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_LIST)
1326:     {
1327:       return -EINVAL;
1328:     }
1329: 
1330:   flags = up_irq_save();
1331:   if (g_wifi.node_count == WIFI_NODE_QUEUE ||
1332:       (node.channel == 2 &&
1333:        g_wifi.recycle_count == WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE))
1334:     {
1335:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1336:       return -EAGAIN;
1337:     }
1338: 
1339:   pending = &g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_tail];
1340:   memset(pending, 0, sizeof(*pending));
1341:   pending->node = node;
1342:   pending->generation = bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation();
1343:   if (node.channel == 2)
1344:     {
1345:       struct wifi_recycle_entry *entry =
1346:         &g_wifi.recycle[g_wifi.recycle_tail];
1347: 
1348:       memset(entry, 0, sizeof(*entry));
1349:       entry->generation = pending->generation;
1350:       entry->state = WIFI_RECYCLE_RESERVED;
1351:       pending->recycle_index = g_wifi.recycle_tail;
1352:       pending->recycle_reserved = true;
1353:       g_wifi.recycle_tail = (g_wifi.recycle_tail + 1) %
1354:                             WIFI_RECYCLE_QUEUE;
1355:       g_wifi.recycle_count++;
1356:     }
1357: 
1358:   g_wifi.node_tail = (g_wifi.node_tail + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1359:   g_wifi.node_count++;
1360:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1361:   nxsem_post(&g_wifi.work_sem);
1362:   return OK;
1363: }

1375: static int wifi_worker(int argc, char **argv)
1376: {
1377:   (void)argc;
1378:   (void)argv;
1379:   for (;;)
1380:     {
1381:       struct wifi_pending_node pending;
1382:       struct wifi_net_notifications notifications;
1383:       irqstate_t flags;
1384: 
1385:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.work_sem,
1386:                                            WIFI_WORK_INTERVAL);
1387:       memset(&notifications, 0, sizeof(notifications));
1388:       (void)wifi_sync_reset_generation();
1389:       wifi_collect_rejected_tx(&notifications);
1390:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1391:       for (;;)
1392:         {
1393:           if (bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation() !=
1394:               g_wifi.reset_generation)
1395:             {
1396:               (void)wifi_sync_reset_generation();
1397:             }
1398: 
1399:           nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1400:           flags = up_irq_save();
1401:           if (g_wifi.node_count == 0)
1402:             {
1403:               up_irq_restore(flags);
1404:               nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1405:               break;
1406:             }
1407: 
1408:           pending = g_wifi.nodes[g_wifi.node_head];
1409:           g_wifi.node_head = (g_wifi.node_head + 1) % WIFI_NODE_QUEUE;
1410:           g_wifi.node_count--;
1411:           up_irq_restore(flags);
1412:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1413:           if (pending.generation != g_wifi.reset_generation)
1414:             {
1415:               if (pending.recycle_reserved)
1416:                 {
1417:                   flags = up_irq_save();
1418:                   g_wifi.recycle[pending.recycle_index].state =
1419:                     WIFI_RECYCLE_DISCARD;
1420:                   up_irq_restore(flags);
1421:                 }
1422:             }
1423:           else if (pending.node.channel == 0)
1424:             {
1425:               wifi_handle_command_list(&pending.node,
1426:                                        pending.generation);
1427:             }
1428:           else if (pending.node.channel == 2)
1429:             {
1430:               wifi_handle_data(&pending, &notifications);
1431:             }
1432:           bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
1433:         }
1434: 
1435:       wifi_flush_recycle();
1436:       wifi_notify_network(&notifications);
1437:     }
1438: 
1439:   return OK;
1440: }

1455: static int wifi_transmit(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower, netpkt_t *packet)
1456: {
1457:   struct wifi_tx_slot *tx = NULL;
1458:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
1459:   unsigned int length;
1460:   unsigned int i;
1461:   int ret;
1462: 
1463:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1464:   length = netpkt_getdatalen(lower, packet);
1465:   if (!g_wifi.carrier || !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1466:     {
1467:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1468:       return -ENETDOWN;
1469:     }
1470:   if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME)
1471:     {
1472:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1473:       return -EMSGSIZE;
1474:     }
1475: 
1476:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI_TX_SLOTS; i++)
1477:     {
1478:       if (!g_wifi.tx[i].active && !g_wifi.tx[i].transport_pending)
1479:         {
1480:           tx = &g_wifi.tx[i];
1481:           break;
1482:         }
1483:     }
1484:   if (tx == NULL)
1485:     {
1486:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1487:       return -EBUSY;
1488:     }
1489: 
1490:   memset(&tx->pbuf, 0, sizeof(tx->pbuf));
1491:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1492:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu));
1493:   tx->pbuf.payload = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)tx->frame;
1494:   tx->pbuf.tot_len = length;
1495:   tx->pbuf.len = length;
1496:   tx->pbuf.type_internal = WIFI_PBUF_TYPE_RAM;
1497:   tx->pbuf.ref = 1;
1498:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + length;
1499:   cpdu->type_dst = 2u;
1500:   ret = netpkt_copyout(lower, tx->frame, packet, length, 0);
1501:   if (ret < 0)
1502:     {
1503:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1504:       return ret;
1505:     }
1506: 
1507:   tx->packet = packet;
1508:   tx->active = true;
1509:   tx->transport_pending = true;
1510:   tx->transport_rejected = false;
1511:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_DATA_TX_CHANNEL, 2,
1512:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
1513:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1,
1514:                        wifi_tx_transport_complete, tx);
1515:   if (ret < 0)
1516:     {
1517:       tx->packet = NULL;
1518:       tx->active = false;
1519:       tx->transport_pending = false;
1520:     }
1521:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1522:   return ret;
1523: }

1560:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1561:   return packet;

1746: static int wifi_scan(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *lower,
1747:                       struct iwreq *request, bool set)
1748: {
1749:   uint8_t ssid[33];
1750:   int32_t status;
1751:   uint16_t result_length;
1752:   int ret;
1753: 
1754:   (void)lower;
1755:   if (request == NULL)
1756:     {
1757:       return -EINVAL;
1758:     }
1759:   if (!set)
1760:     {
1761:       nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1762:       if (g_wifi.scan_running)
1763:         {
1764:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1765:           return -EAGAIN;
1766:         }
1767:       if (!g_wifi.scan_cached)
1768:         {
1769:           ret = wifi_scan_cache_fetch();
1770:           if (ret < 0)
1771:             {
1772:               nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1773:               return ret;
1774:             }
1775:         }
1776:       if (request->u.data.pointer == NULL ||
1777:           request->u.data.length < g_wifi.scan_cache_length)
1778:         {
1779:           request->u.data.length = g_wifi.scan_cache_length;
1780:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1781:           return -E2BIG;
1782:         }
1783:       memcpy(request->u.data.pointer, g_wifi.scan_cache,
1784:              g_wifi.scan_cache_length);
1785:       request->u.data.length = g_wifi.scan_cache_length;
1786:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1787:       return OK;
1788:     }
1789: 
1790:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.scan_lock);
1791:   wifi_scan_cache_clear();
1792:   memset(ssid, 0, sizeof(ssid));
1793:   if ((request->u.data.flags & IW_SCAN_THIS_ESSID) != 0 &&
1794:       request->u.data.pointer != NULL &&
1795:       request->u.data.length >= sizeof(struct iw_scan_req))
1796:     {
1797:       const struct iw_scan_req *scan = request->u.data.pointer;
1798:       size_t length = scan->essid_len;
1799: 
1800:       if (length > sizeof(ssid) - 1)
1801:         {
1802:           length = sizeof(ssid) - 1;
1803:         }
1804:       memcpy(ssid, scan->essid, length);
1805:     }
1806:   result_length = 0;
1807:   status = 0;
1808:   ret = wifi_command(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_SCAN_WIFI, ssid, sizeof(ssid),
1809:                      &status, sizeof(status), &result_length);
1810:   if (ret >= 0 && result_length != sizeof(status))
1811:     {
1812:       printf("wifi scan start invalid response length: %u\n", result_length);
1813:       ret = -EPROTO;
1814:     }
1815:   else if (ret >= 0 && status != 0)
